exam.title: Statistics - Beginner Exam
exam.subtitle: Fundamentals of Probability and Statistics
exam.instructions: Answer all questions. Show all work and calculations. Permitted aids: Non-programmable calculator, standard normal distribution table. Good luck!

exercises.title: Probability calculation with urn model
exercises.description:
An urn contains 5 red, 3 blue, and 2 green balls. One ball is drawn randomly.

a) What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
b) What is the probability of not drawing a green ball?
c) Calculate P(red or blue).
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Determine total number of balls
Total number = 5 (red) + 3 (blue) + 2 (green) = 10 balls

Step 2: Part a) - Probability of red ball
P(red) = Number of red balls / Total number = 5/10 = 1/2 = 0.5

Step 3: Part b) - Probability of not drawing green ball
P(not green) = 1 - P(green) = 1 - 2/10 = 1 - 1/5 = 4/5 = 0.8
Alternatively: P(not green) = (5 + 3)/10 = 8/10 = 0.8

Step 4: Part c) - P(red or blue)
Since "red" and "blue" are mutually exclusive events:
P(red or blue) = P(red) + P(blue) = 5/10 + 3/10 = 8/10 = 4/5 = 0.8

Step 5: Answers
a) P(red) = 0.5
b) P(not green) = 0.8
c) P(red or blue) = 0.8

exercises.title: Permutations and combinations
exercises.description:
A class consists of 12 students.

a) In how many ways can 3 students be chosen for class president, vice president, and treasurer?
b) In how many ways can a 4-member delegation be selected?
c) How many different seating arrangements are there for all 12 students?
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Part a) - Permutation without repetition
Here order matters (different positions).
Number = P(12,3) = 12!/(12-3)! = 12!/9! = 12 × 11 × 10 = 1320

Step 2: Part b) - Combination without repetition
Here order doesn't matter (delegation).
Number = C(12,4) = 12!/(4! × (12-4)!) = 12!/(4! × 8!)

Step 4: Part c) - Permutation of all elements
Number of seating arrangements = 12! = 479,001,600

Step 5: Answers
a) 1320 possibilities for the positions
b) 495 possibilities for the delegation
c) 479,001,600 different seating arrangements

exercises.title: Tree diagram and Bayes' theorem
exercises.description:
A company produces parts on two machines. Machine A produces 60% of all parts, Machine B produces 40%. The defect rate is 2% for Machine A and 5% for Machine B.

a) What is the probability that a randomly selected part is defective?
b) A part is defective. What is the probability that it came from Machine A?
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Given information
P(A) = 0.6, P(B) = 0.4
P(defective|A) = 0.02, P(defective|B) = 0.05
P(intact|A) = 0.98, P(intact|B) = 0.95

Step 2: Part a) - Total probability
P(defective) = P(defective|A) × P(A) + P(defective|B) × P(B)
P(defective) = 0.02 × 0.6 + 0.05 × 0.4 = 0.012 + 0.02 = 0.032

Step 3: Part b) - Bayes' theorem
P(A|defective) = P(defective|A) × P(A) / P(defective)
P(A|defective) = (0.02 × 0.6) / 0.032 = 0.012 / 0.032 = 0.375

Step 4: Verification
P(B|defective) = P(defective|B) × P(B) / P(defective)
P(B|defective) = (0.05 × 0.4) / 0.032 = 0.02 / 0.032 = 0.625
Check: 0.375 + 0.625 = 1 ✓

Step 5: Answers
a) P(defective) = 0.032 = 3.2%
b) P(A|defective) = 0.375 = 37.5%

exercises.title: Binomial distribution
exercises.description:
The probability that a student passes an exam is 0.8. In a group of 10 students:

a) What is the probability that exactly 8 students pass?
b) What is the probability that at least 7 students pass?
c) Calculate the expected value and variance.
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Binomial distribution parameters
n = 10 (number of students)
p = 0.8 (success probability)
X ~ B(10; 0.8)

Step 5: Part c) - Expected value and variance
E(X) = n × p = 10 × 0.8 = 8
Var(X) = n × p × (1-p) = 10 × 0.8 × 0.2 = 1.6
Standard deviation: σ = √1.6 ≈ 1.265

exercises.title: Normal distribution
exercises.description:
The height of men is normally distributed with μ = 175 cm and σ = 8 cm.

a) What is the probability that a randomly selected man is between 170 and 180 cm tall?
b) What height is not exceeded by 90% of men?
c) What is the proportion of men taller than 185 cm?
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Standardization
X ~ N(175, 8²)
Standardization: Z = (X - μ)/σ = (X - 175)/8
Z ~ N(0,1)

Step 4: Part b) - 90% quantile
Sought: x₀.₉ with P(X ≤ x₀.₉) = 0.9
P(Z ≤ (x₀.₉ - 175)/8) = 0.9
From table: z₀.₉ ≈ 1.28
(x₀.₉ - 175)/8 = 1.28
x₀.₉ = 175 + 8 × 1.28 = 175 + 10.24 = 185.24 cm

exercises.title: Measures of central tendency and dispersion
exercises.description:
Given are the grades from an exam: 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5

a) Calculate the arithmetic mean.
b) Determine the median and mode.
c) Calculate the variance and standard deviation.
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Sort and analyze data
Sorted data: 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5
Number n = 9

Step 2: Part a) - Arithmetic mean
$\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i = \frac{1 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 5}{9}$
$\bar{x} = \frac{27}{9} = 3$

Step 3: Part b) - Median
With n = 9 (odd): Median = x₍₅₎ (5th value)
Median = 3
Mode: Most frequent value is 3 (appears 3 times)
Mode = 3

Step 5: Variance and standard deviation
$s^2 = \frac{4 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 1 + 4}{9-1} = \frac{12}{8} = 1.5$
Standard deviation: $s = \sqrt{1.5} ≈ 1.225$

Step 6: Answers
a) Arithmetic mean: $\bar{x} = 3$
b) Median = 3, Mode = 3
c) Variance = 1.5, Standard deviation ≈ 1.225
